title: Stack Nudge workflow: stacked-PR nudge posts once per PR, only for member/owner/collaborator authors, and skips native stacks
answers: Why did the bot post a 'use GitHub native stacks' comment on my PR?
Why does the stacked PR nudge repeat every time I edit the PR description?
Which authors trigger the stacked PR nudge, and how do I exclude native stacks or bots?
Where is the duplicate-suppression marker for the stack nudge checked?
body:
Path: .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml:nudge job, triggered by pull_request_target opened/edited. It posts the stacked-PR recommendation when the PR body contains the phrase "🥞 Stacked PR" and the author is not a Bot and has author_association MEMBER, OWNER, or COLLABORATOR, and the PR is not already a native stack (github.event.pull_request.stack is empty).
Rule: Before commenting, read existing PR comments with `gh pr view --json comments` and skip if a comment by login `github-actions` contains the hidden marker `<!-- mlflow-stack-nudge -->`. Match the login `github-actions` (the GraphQL login gh returns), not `github-actions[bot]` (the REST login); the wrong login makes the marker check never match.
Symptom: Each qualifying `edited` event posted another nudge comment, because the duplicate check never recognized the bot's earlier comment.
Constraints: Applies to this workflow only. The job runs under pull_request_target, so it uses inline shell and gh without checking out the repository. Does not cover the advice.js advice comment.
applies: Stacked-PR nudge comments on pull requests in the MLflow repo's GitHub Actions workflows.
says: The automated bot repeatedly posts stacked pull request advice every time I edit the description.
Why does the pull request helper keep posting duplicate comments about native stacked changes?
The stacked pull request nudge should only post once per pull request instead of repeating.
Stop the pull request bot from spamming stack recommendations when updating the overview text.
search: In .github/workflows/stack-nudge.yml:nudge, suppress duplicate stacked-PR nudge comments on PR open and edit events by reading existing comments with gh pr view --json comments and matching the hidden marker <!-- mlflow-stack-nudge --> under login github-actions. Matching github-actions instead of github-actions[bot] prevents repeated nudge comments on every qualifying PR edit event. The workflow triggers when the PR body contains '🥞 Stacked PR', the author is not a bot, has author_association MEMBER, OWNER, or COLLABORATOR, and github.event.pull_request.stack is empty. The job runs under pull_request_target using inline shell and gh without checking out the repository, and does not cover advice.js.
